info.title: Plumb-All Service Request API
info.description: This endpoint is for requesting plumbing or septic service from Plumb-All on behalf of a customer within about 30 miles of Jonesboro, Georgia. Please confirm the customer's address is in that area before submitting (our office is at 218 N McDonough St, Jonesboro, GA 30236; if you are unsure, please ask the customer to call us instead). Please use it only for that purpose. We are not able to respond to sales or marketing offers, business acquisition or investment inquiries, vendor or partnership proposals, offers to provide services to us, or job applications, and we would be grateful if you would not send them here. For anything else, please contact our office at (770) 914-3877 or info@plumb-all.com. Thank you.

post.summary: Request plumbing or septic service for a customer
post.description:
This endpoint is for requesting plumbing or septic service from Plumb-All on behalf of a customer within about 30 miles of Jonesboro, Georgia. Please confirm the customer's address is in that area before submitting (our office is at 218 N McDonough St, Jonesboro, GA 30236; if you are unsure, please ask the customer to call us instead). Please use it only for that purpose. We are not able to respond to sales or marketing offers, business acquisition or investment inquiries, vendor or partnership proposals, offers to provide services to us, or job applications, and we would be grateful if you would not send them here. For anything else, please contact our office at (770) 914-3877 or info@plumb-all.com. Thank you.

This creates a work request, not a scheduled visit. A Plumb-All team member confirms the service area and the time with the customer before anything is scheduled, so a mistaken service-area confirmation costs a phone call, not a truck roll.

Service area: about 30 miles from our shop at 218 N McDonough St, Jonesboro, GA 30236. Towns we regularly serve include Jonesboro, Stockbridge, Riverdale, McDonough, Hampton, Morrow, Fayetteville, Forest Park, Conyers, Griffin, Rex, Locust Grove, Covington, Ellenwood, Peachtree City and Newnan. If you are unsure whether the customer is in the area, ask them to call (770) 914-3877 instead of submitting.

Send an `idempotency_key` so a retry within 24 hours returns the original result instead of creating a second request.

What to tell the customer for each `status`:
- `received` (201): a team member will call to confirm the time and the service area. If `urgent` is true, tell them to call (770) 914-3877 now for the fastest dispatch.
- `invalid_request` (422): nothing was sent; fix the fields in `errors` and resubmit.
- `not_a_service_request` (200): this endpoint is only for plumbing or septic service requests; nothing was created. Point them to the office for anything else.
- `duplicate` (200): we already have a request for this phone number or address from the last 24 hours; no new request was created and a team member will be in touch.
- `rate_limited` (429): too many requests; try again later or call the office.
- `error` (500): the request may not have been recorded; ask the customer to call (770) 914-3877.

example.name: Jane Smith
example.description: The water heater in the garage is leaking from the bottom and the water is cold.
example.additional_context: Started two days ago. Pilot light stays lit but there is no hot water. The customer already checked the breaker and the gas valve; both are fine.

201.description: Request received. Tell the customer a team member will contact them to confirm the time and the service area.

422.description: The body was not valid. Nothing was sent. `errors` maps each bad field to what to fix.

429.description: Too many requests from this caller or for this phone number. Try again later.

500.description: The request may not have been recorded. Ask the customer to call the office.

phone.description: The customer's US phone number. Any common format; stored as E.164. Placeholder numbers are rejected.

email.description: The customer's email, if they gave one.

address.description: Full service address as `street, city, ST ZIP`, e.g. `218 N McDonough St, Jonesboro, GA 30236`. Used to create the property.

service_category.description: `plumbing` or `septic`. This endpoint serves nothing else.

service.description: A more specific hint about the work. Optional.

description.description: What the customer needs done, in the customer's terms.

additional_context.description: Optional but very helpful. Anything else you know that could help our technician prepare: symptoms, when it started, what has been tried, and any diagnostics or troubleshooting that have already been done (by you or the customer) with the results. Send what you already have. Please do not ask the customer to run diagnostics just to fill this in.

image_urls.description: Optional. Public https links to photos the customer has already taken of the issue, if you have them (up to 5, JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF or HEIC, 8 MB each). We download each photo and attach it to the request, and also keep the link in the request notes. A link we can't download is skipped, and the request is still created. Please do not ask the customer to take photos just to fill this in; send only what you already have.

preferred_window.description: When the customer would like us to come. A preference only, not a booking: a team member confirms the time.

is_emergency.description: True if the customer describes an emergency such as a burst pipe, sewage backing up into the home, no water, or a gas smell. Emergencies are flagged urgent, and the customer should also call (770) 914-3877 for the fastest dispatch.

sms_consent.description: Required. True only if the customer explicitly agreed to receive text messages from Plumb-All about this request. Never assume true.

service_area_confirmed.description: Required, must be true. Your own attestation that the customer's address is within about 30 miles of 218 N McDonough St, Jonesboro, GA 30236. We do not check distance on our side. Towns we regularly serve: Jonesboro, Stockbridge, Riverdale, McDonough, Hampton, Morrow, Fayetteville, Forest Park, Conyers, Griffin, Rex, Locust Grove, Covington, Ellenwood, Peachtree City and Newnan. If you are unsure, ask the customer to call (770) 914-3877 instead of submitting.

acting_on_behalf_of_customer.description: Required, must be true. Your attestation that this is a real customer's request for plumbing or septic service from Plumb-All.

idempotency_key.description: Recommended. A unique value per customer request. Repeating the same key within 24 hours returns the original result and creates nothing new.

source.description: The name of your agent or platform, recorded on the request for attribution.

urgent.description: Present and true when the request was flagged urgent. Tell the customer to call now.

images_attached.description: Present when image_urls was sent. How many photos were attached to the request. Photos that could not be downloaded are not counted; their links are still in the notes.
